chapter_mission: Ben first tries the ordinary Jedi path during the collapse. It is too slow. Remembering Iressa emotionally rather than philosophically, he acts decisively with Jacen-shaped crisis clarity and saves lives. Some people are grateful; some are shaken by how it felt to be moved or commanded.
chapter_turn: Aevyn recognizes the pattern: Jacen taught Ben that.
